description: Source code for handling PKCS#8 private key encoding and decoding in OpenSSL, including functions for writing, reading, encrypting, and decrypting private keys in PKCS#8 format.

methods.name: PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format with specified NID to BIO.

methods.name: PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format to BIO, optionally encrypted.

methods.name: i2d_PKCS8PrivateKey_bio
methods.description: Serializes a private key in PKCS#8 format to BIO.

methods.name: i2d_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid_bio
methods.description: Serializes a private key in PKCS#8 format with specified NID to BIO.

methods.name: d2i_PKCS8PrivateKey_bio
methods.description: Deserializes a PKCS#8 private key from BIO.

methods.name: d2i_PKCS8PrivateKey_fp
methods.description: Deserializes a PKCS#8 private key from FILE pointer.
